part.text:
The images are ready. ✅

**`/work/SystemContext.svg`** — the workspace defines exactly one view (`SystemContext`), so there is one image file.

A note on how it was produced: this environment has no local renderers (no Java/PlantUML, no Graphviz, no Python/Node) and no network access (PlantUML server, mermaid.ink, and package repos are all unreachable), so I couldn't run a standard Structurizr/PlantUML pipeline. Instead I exported the view's structure via the Structurizr tooling and hand-authored the SVG, following the C4-PlantUML conventions:

- **Layout**: left-to-right, matching the view's `autoLayout` setting
- **Elements**: `Patron` (person, `#084270`) → `Library` (software system, `#1168bd`), each with its description
- **Relationship**: "Browses the catalogue through" with `HTTPS` technology label
- **Title**: "System Context View: Library"

If you'd prefer PNG output, that would require either network access (for a rendering service) or a local toolchain (e.g. `apk add plantuml` + Java) — happy to do that if you can provide one.
